info.title: MoneyFlex API
info.description:
A REST API over customers and the services they hold. Each customer may
have many services.

**Authentication**

Every endpoint except the health check and login requires credentials.
Two schemes are accepted and either is sufficient:

- `basicAuth` — HTTP Basic, the scheme the API is required to support.
- `bearerAuth` — a JWT obtained from `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.

Use the **Authorize** button above to supply either one. The seeded
account is `api@moneyflex.test` / `password123`.

post.summary: Exchange credentials for a bearer token
post.description: Open endpoint. Rate limited to five attempts per minute per account and address.

401.description: The credentials were not accepted. The response is identical whether or not the account exists.

429.description: Too many attempts. A Retry-After header states when to try again.

get.description: Accepts either scheme, so it doubles as a way to check that credentials work.

post.summary: Exchange a token for a fresh one
post.description: The presented token is revoked in the same step, so it cannot be replayed. Refreshing is only possible within the refresh window measured from the original issue time.
The token is held on a denylist until the moment it would have expired on its own.

post.summary: Create a service for a customer
post.description: The owner is taken from the URL. A customer_id in the body is ignored, so a service can never be attached to another account.

ends_at.description: Must not be earlier than starts_at.

id.description:
The document level OpenAPI definition: metadata, servers, the two accepted
security schemes, and the schemas shared across endpoints.

This class holds no behaviour. It exists so the specification is written in
one readable place instead of being scattered across controllers.

services_count.description: Present on listings and single reads.

price.description: A decimal carried as a string so it never loses precision in transit.
